subject: Keep WIP status local to real local workers
description: Investigate and fix WIP status inheritance where tasks in progress elsewhere appear as local WIP without a local agent backing them. Success: local WIP indicators are derived only from local registered workers/worktrees/session evidence, with a focused test or existing test coverage updated.

summary: Changed dashboard WIP to be local-only: /state now exposes statuses.local_in_progress using the existing vouchedLive agent liveness check, while global in_progress remains unchanged. The graph UI uses local_in_progress for the WIP dock and only applies WIP shine to in-progress nodes assigned to a currently running local agent. Added test/local-wip-status.test.js covering inherited in-progress status without a local agent and stale local agent records.
